text:
Claire (PM): Quick request  we need a compact launch kit for the Inference Spotlight webinar. Deliverables: micro-GIF hero (1200x628) + MP4 fallback, three benchmark card templates (800x800 & 1200x628), Figma components, and a short README with export presets and filename conventions. Include alt text samples and two palettes (brand + high-contrast). Also: A/B copy variants and JP/FR/DE localization. Target first drafts by Tue EOD. @Raj @Kenji @Noelle

Raj (Design): On it. Ill do an animated sparkline hero and a static frame hero to keep sizes down. Will add components with named layers for CSV swaps. GIFs optimized + MP4 H.264 provided.

Noelle (Growth): Please add a tiny routing manifest mapping filenames to UTM templates so our landing page can auto-assign cohorts. Also include a naming pattern like `redwood_spot_{role}_{variant}_v{n}_{lang}`.

Kenji (L10n): I need the final EN copy by Mon 6pm PST to localize JP/FR/DE. JP CTAs need short variants (~1216 chars).

Raj (Design): README will include export sizes, alt text examples, aria-label guidance for animated elements, and the assets->UTM manifest. Ill also add a microtile CSV example and a tiny Node snippet for CSV->PNG exports.

Claire (PM): Add a QA checklist: logo lockups, clearspace, font weights, forbidden swatches, and route copy to legal@redwood.ai for EU wording. Tag me when the Figma link is up.

DesignOps: Storage note  final kit goes to `marketing/webinars/2026-04-spotlight` with comment access for reviewers.

Raj (Design): First-pass Figma by Tue noon PST. Will ping when live. :thumbsup:
